website-edunora.description: Edunora website design project by SoftBuild VN: Solution to digitize the aesthetic training system, automate enrollment and optimize UI/UX, reduce page load speed.
website-edunora.contentHtml:
Project overview

The Edunora website project is a professional medical information portal and online appointment management solution developed bySoftBuilddesign and construction. The new online system helps digitize the automatic medical appointment booking process and optimize customer experience in the Hanoi area.

  • Industry and Field:Medical and cosmetic health care and beauty services
  • Year of implementation: 2025
  • Number of personnel performing:3 people
  • Service:Website design for specialized clinics
  • Implementation time:2 months
  • Support tools:WordPress, PHP language, MySQL database, Google Analytics 4, Rank Math.

Introducing customers

Edunora is a professional medical facility specializing in providing prestigious high-tech cosmetic solutions in the Hanoi market. Operating in the field of health and beauty care services, the clinic provides non-invasive beauty treatments including skin rejuvenation with high-tech machines, wrinkle removal injections, and specialized structural cosmetic surgery. Edunora is always committed to providing safe, medical-standard treatment procedures that help enhance natural beauty and bring comprehensive confidence to customers.

Context of the field in which the website operates

The cosmetic medical service industry requires websites to present accurate and clear medical information to build solid trust. When looking into treatments, customers always want to refer to the transparent treatment process and the capacity profile of the team of experts. Solution implementationBenefits of website design for spas and beauty salonsProfessionalism will help clinics optimize the process of interacting and connecting with customers online effectively.

Challenge

Before cooperating with SoftBuild, Edunora's old website encountered many major technical barriers. The average page load time is up to 8.2 seconds due to the volume of unoptimized high-capacity clinical images, causing the bounce rate to reach 74%. The information structure of the process of performing liposuction or filler injection lacks expertise, reducing brand reputation, leading to an appointment booking rate of only 0.4%. At the same time, the manual process of receiving customer information over the phone often causes duplicate doctor's examination schedules at facilities on Do Quang street and Vu Thanh street.

Solution from SoftBuild

The engineering team at SoftBuild has programmed a new website system with a focus on optimizing data download speed and automating appointment management.

Meaning of medical-standard flat interface design

The website chooses a minimalist flat design style and scientific white space allocation to separate blocks of in-depth medical knowledge. Excess graphic details are completely eliminated to direct customers' attention to images of clinical treatment results. The system's color tones are strictly synchronized with Edunora's brand identity. Call-to-action buttons to schedule an in-depth examination are highlighted in contrasting colors and conveniently arranged according to page scrolling behavior to comply with UI/UX standard interface rules of the medical industry.

Digitize doctor records and automate appointment scheduling

We have built smart online interactive tools to upgrade performance:

  • Module for automatic medical examination scheduling:Allows customers to choose their desired examination facility and time, then automatically compare the doctor's work schedule to confirm the appointment into the internal management system.
  • Expert electronic records system:Presents detailed information about the doctor's credentials and links directly to images of actual treatment results they have performed.
  • Digital map locating clinic facilities:Integrating the exact coordinates of the facility in Yen Hoa and O Cho Dua wards into the online map system helps customers easily calculate travel distance.
  • Image optimization technology:Convert entire photo archive to WebP image format combined with asynchronous data loading technology to display high-definition images instantly without clogging the server.

Applied programming language

The system operates sustainably thanks to modern programming technologies:

  • PHP language:Server-side logic processing engine helps operate the online booking form system and securely encrypts customers' personal information.
  • JavaScript language:The tool handles dynamic browser interactions, including optimizing the display of customer treatment results comparison images.
  • MySQL database management system:High-speed database system is used to securely store customer registration records and track appointment history.
  • HTML5 language and CSS3 format:The grid-based page layout toolkit helps medical information display clearly and coherently on both computer screens and mobile devices.
  • WordPress system:The content management platform helps Edunora's team easily update new cosmetic service information and adjust medical notifications.

Customer reviews

Edunora brand representative shared his satisfaction:"The new website structure built by SoftBuild has accurately solved the clinic's operational problems. Images of treatment results are displayed quickly and the online appointment booking feature works accurately, helping us save significant time."

Actual data results

The project has recorded many clear improvements after three months of putting the new system into operation:

  • Mobile page loading speed decreased sharply from 8.2 seconds to only 0.8 seconds.
  • Page load performance score reached 96 points on a scale of 100 according to Google standards.
  • Page bounce rate decreased sharply from 74% to 28% accompanied by a 30% increase in organic traffic.
  • The time customers stay to learn medical information on the website increased by 40%, reaching an average of 4 minutes and 15 seconds.
  • The online booking rate increased from 1.4% to 4.5%, accompanied by a decrease in doctor's scheduling errors.
  • The customer satisfaction rate for the information search experience reached 98%.

Conclusion

The online system upgrade project for Edunora affirms SoftBuild's ability to provide highly practical technology solutions. Solving speed problems and automating processes has helped the clinic consolidate its solid medical reputation. Partners operating in the beauty industry can refer to additional servicesWebsite design for beauty spa and salonof us to start building your own project. SoftBuild is committed to programming solutions that always comply with long-term SEO standard data structures to optimize display rankings.

Implementation of solutionsinterior website designProfessionalism combined with a quick payment process will help businesses improve their reputation. Applying new technology will help business units increase the speed of reaching partners and retail customers in urban areas effectively.

Applied programming language

  • HTML5 language and CSS3 format:The tool for setting up accurate page structure helps keep images of office tables and chairs balanced and sharp on all types of screens.
  • JavaScript language:Tool to handle promotion countdown effects and support the feature of quickly copying customer discount codes.
  • WordPress system combined with WooCommerce:A powerful core platform supports businesses in managing inventory and automatically updating price lists and controlling the online payment process.

Customer reviews

Virela Interior representative shared about the change:"The new website designed by SoftBuild runs very quickly and is easy to use. Customers can now view table and chair specifications themselves and save discount codes to order directly, very conveniently, helping us save time managing orders every day."

Actual data results

The project has achieved many specific measurable results after two months of operation:

  • Page loading speed decreased sharply from 4.2 seconds to only 1.2 seconds, making the product viewing experience smoother.
  • The order conversion rate on the website increased by 35%, accompanied by an increase in online revenue of 25%.
  • The time customers stay to learn product information on the website increases by 40%.
  • Bounce rate is reduced by 30% thanks to a minimalist one-step checkout interface.

The Virela Interior project has confirmed the effectiveness of e-commerce website design that closely follows customers' actual shopping behavior. website-ceranova.contentHtml:
Project overview

Ceranova website project is a professional online export solution developed bySoftBuilddesign and construction. The new digital platform helps enhance the ceramic product catalog and build a direct interaction portal with international wholesalers and import partners.

  • Year of implementation: 2024
  • Number of personnel performing:4 people
  • Service:B2B product catalog website design
  • Implementation time:one and a half months
  • Support tools:WordPress, Catalog Mode quote module, PHP language, Google Analytics, Rank Math.

Introducing customers

Ceranova is a reputable brand of manufacturing and exporting fine art ceramics, specializing in supplying high-end ceramic pot collections to international wholesale importers and agents. Operating in the fields of e-commerce and architecture, the business provides an extremely diverse product portfolio including Terracotta pots and Glazed pots and a line of ultra-lightweight GRC composite cement pots. Ceranova focuses on bringing sophisticated ceramic products that meet strict technical standards to serve key markets such as North America and Europe.

Context of the field in which the website operates

The fine-art ceramic export industry requires websites to display high-resolution images so that foreign customers can clearly see the details of the glaze and material of ceramic pots. Wholesale business customers, when sourcing goods, always search based on clear specifications. Solution implementationCeramics website designProfessionally integrated portal to collect quotation requests will help businesses effectively access large distributors globally.

Challenge

Before cooperating with SoftBuild, Ceranova's website faced a major barrier in terms of remote page loading speed in Western countries of up to 6.5 to 8 seconds, sharply increasing the page bounce rate. The old ceramic pot classification system is not scientific, making it difficult to look up pots by each type of material such as High Fired pots or Poly and Fiberstone materials and GRC composite materials. At the same time, the lack of the feature to group wholesale products to send bulk quote requests for a container makes the order closing process time-consuming for the sales department.

Solution from SoftBuild

To completely solve the above limitations, SoftBuild has designed a new structure for the website according to B2B export standards.

The meaning of interface design honors the product

The website interface uses white space as the main color to highlight the natural color of terracotta and the characteristic ceramic glaze. The dark red letter tones are harmoniously combined to create a rustic, artistic feeling suitable for the ceramic industry. The parameter blocks are arranged in a scientific grid structure and comply with UI/UX standard interface rules to help international customers focus on the product without being distracted by graphic elements.

Breakthrough features for the wholesale business model

We have built modern software tools to improve order closing efficiency:

  • B2B quote basket system:Allows wholesalers to add product codes in bulk to quote lists and send specific quantity requests directly to Ceranova.
  • Optimize global display performance:Combining a global content distribution server system and WebP image format to reduce image size by 65% while maintaining sharpness, helping pages load smoothly in the US and UK.
  • Professional product classification:Build precise subcategories by material like Bubble Pot ceramic pots or similarly styled Glazed Pot ceramic potsWebsite design selling ceramicsmodern.
  • Advanced product filters:Help partners quickly filter ceramic pots by material, color, and round or square shape without reloading the entire website.

Applied programming language

The website operates smoothly thanks to the application of standard programming languages:

  • PHP language and MySQL database:The toolkit handles logical calculation operations and manages the data system of a catalog of thousands of export ceramic pots and quotation information from partners.
  • HTML5 language and CSS3 format:The tool sets up website structure to display correctly and helps product images stay sharp on all screen sizes.
  • JavaScript language and AJAX techniques:The toolkit handles product filtering interactions and adding pot codes to the wholesale quote cart smoothly without reloading the entire site.
  • WordPress system:Flexible content management platform makes it easy for businesses to upload new collections and control daily customer contact lists.

Customer reviews

Ceranova representatives shared their satisfaction:"The design from SoftBuild really solves our most difficult problem, which is the speed of displaying images with international partners. Currently, importers in the US or UK can zoom in to clearly see each enamel crack on the ceramic pot and the website still runs very quickly. Switching to a quote request system also helps our sales department work more efficiently by receiving accurate and clear request information from customers instead of having to exchange emails many times like first.”

Actual data results

The project has recorded many impressive growth indicators after three months of operation:

  • Page loading speed in the US and UK markets decreased sharply from 7 seconds to 1.5 seconds.
  • The number of quote request forms from international partners increased by 42%.
  • The page bounce rate decreased by 34% with the average visit time increasing to 4 minutes and 12 seconds.
  • Save 15% on server operating costs by optimizing source code and reducing image bandwidth.
  • The user retention rate on the website reaches 90%.
  • Customer satisfaction with the interface experience reached 99%.

Conclusion

The Ceranova website project is a testament to the application of modern image technology to solve the online export problem of businesses. SoftBuild is proud to bring international standard digital showroom solutions to help elevate Vietnamese brands in the world. We are committed to source code structure that always complies with standardsSEOlong term to optimize business efficiency.

Introducing customers

Rovena Travel is a professional travel company specializing in providing domestic and international tour packages along with visa support services and online hotel bookings. Operating in the field of tourism and e-commerce services, the business provides diverse itinerary programs to help connect customers with perfect vacation experiences. Rovena Travel is committed to optimizing the booking process to bring maximum convenience to passengers on every trip.

Context of the field in which the website operates

The online travel service industry requires websites to display large amounts of high-quality images to attract users. Customers looking for vacation tours always want to quickly look up specific schedules and make convenient online booking transactions. Implementation of solutionsFull package travel website design serviceProfessionalism will help travel agencies digitize operating processes and enhance brand reputation on the internet.

Challenge

Before cooperating with SoftBuild, Rovena Travel's old website had great difficulty with mobile page loading speed of up to 7.5 seconds, causing a high bounce rate of 68%. The complex tour booking process through many intermediate steps causes the cart abandonment rate at the form filling step to be up to 75%. In addition, manually updating the number of seats causes overcrowding during the peak tourist season and slows down the speed of responding to information to customers.

Solution from SoftBuild

SoftBuild has applied advanced programming techniques to rebuild a new website system for Rovena Travel.

The meaning of content interface design is central

The website uses white space as the main color scheme, harmoniously combined with blue and green colors and warm yellow tones to evoke a feeling of trust. Important information about tour prices and transportation is printed clearly and boldly to help viewers easily grasp the information. The layout strictly follows UI/UX standard interface rules, providing perfect optimal display on vertical screens of mobile devices.

We have programmed smart feature modules to perfect business processes:

  • Shorten the service booking process:Simplify the tour booking steps to 3 steps from selecting dates and number of members to filling in basic information and paying via VNPay portal or credit card.
  • Automatically update blank spaces:Develop an actual data connection management module that automatically subtracts the number of blank spaces displayed on the customer interface as soon as there is a successful transaction.
  • Optimize display of high quality images:Manual frontend programming combines image delay loading techniques and conversion to WebP image format to reduce page load capacity by 60% while still maintaining sharpness.
  • Smart tour filter:Programming a data connection solution without reloading the page helps users quickly filter results by price and destination at a speed of less than 0.5 seconds.

Applied programming language

The system operates sustainably thanks to the application of modern software languages:

  • PHP language:Server-side logic processing tool helps manage tour booking data and calculate costs according to the number of passengers and synchronize the database.
  • JavaScript language and AJAX techniques:The toolkit handles dynamic interactions such as smart filters and form data validation directly in the browser.
  • HTML5 language and CSS3 format:The tool builds a data structure framework that optimizes natural search and sets up smooth, multi-device responsive motion effects.
  • WordPress system:The deeply refined content management platform supports setting up separate categories for tour and hotel information and visa services.

Customer reviews

Rovena Travel representative expressed joy:"The technological companionship from SoftBuild has completely changed the effectiveness of our online business operations. Not only is the interface beautiful and authentic to tourism, but the most important thing is that the website runs very smoothly and supports customers to book tours and pay very easily, helping online revenue grow by 40%."

Actual data results

The project has brought a strong breakthrough in business indicators after three months of operation:

  • Page loading speed decreased sharply from 7.5 seconds to only 1.5 seconds to help improve user experience.
  • The page bounce rate decreased sharply from 68% to 35% with the average access time increasing to 4 minutes 20 seconds.
  • The cart abandonment rate at the information filling step is reduced by 45%, helping to optimize the sales funnel.
  • The online tour booking conversion rate increased from 0.8% to 3.2%.

The cooperation project with Rovena Travel affirms SoftBuild's outstanding capacity in the fieldtravel website designHigh quality. website-veloura-nails.contentHtml:

Veloura Nails is a brand providing nail care and spa services positioned in the high-quality segment. The website was built to become an automatic online appointment booking system and a channel to display professional nail designs. The core goal of the project is to optimize the customer booking process, reduce manual work load for salon staff, increase local customer reach through SEO and directly drive revenue from the online platform.

  • Year of implementation: 2025
  • Number of personnel: 4
  • Service:Website design
  • Implementation time:1 month
  • Support tools:WordPress, PHP, MySQL, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Local SEO Schema, Booking API.

You can see more:Modern nail website design

Introducing customers

Veloura Nails is a brand providing nail care and spa services positioned in the high-end segment. The salon aims to bring high-quality beauty experiences to local customers.

Market context

The current beauty service industry requires maximum convenience for customers. Consumers increasingly tend to search and book appointments online instead of calling or waiting at the store. Competition in the local area is strong, requiring brands to appear prominently in Google search results and provide a fast closing process.

Challenge

Before partnering with SoftBuild, Veloura Nails faced major operational and revenue problems. The scheduling process via phone and text messages consumes a lot of staff time and easily causes time errors. The lack of a reminder system causes a high rate of customers forgetting their schedules. The old online channel displayed images late, had no clear price list and was completely hidden on the regional Google search page, losing a large number of potential customers.

Solution from SoftBuild

Luxurious and intuitive interface design

The interface uses white and beige as the main color tones to create a clean and premium feeling. The layout is divided into a grid to showcase sharp nail designs. This design combined with prominent Scheduling buttons helps navigate customers quickly to the decision to use the service.

Build a comprehensive automatic scheduling system

The SoftBuild team built a form that allows customers to self-select services, favorite staff and available times instantly. When customers change dates on the form, empty time slots will appear immediately without reloading the page. This feature connects directly to the salon's data system to avoid duplicate schedules, and automatically sends confirmation messages to customers.

Apply modern technology

The website is developed on a smart management system that helps business owners easily update services and control appointment schedules without needing technical knowledge. The entire interface is intuitively designed to ensure sharp images and touch gestures work extremely smoothly on all mobile devices. Platform data is also maximally streamlined to keep page loading speeds fast, helping customers experience the safest and smoothest booking process.

Breakthrough Results and Business Impact

The new system serves as an operational management tool that operates continuously every day. Receptionists are free to focus entirely on customer care at the salon instead of having to constantly answer the phone. Technology products from SoftBuild bring in a stable number of customers with real growth indicators after only 2 months of implementation:

  • Increase conversion rate and revenue from new customers searching through Google by 30%.
  • Increase clicks from local search results by 80%.
  • Page loading speed reached 1.1 seconds compared to the original 4.2 seconds.
  • Reduce the number of calls asking for prices and manual scheduling by 40%.
  • Reduce the rate of guests forgetting appointments by 15% thanks to the automatic message feature.

Customer reviews

Veloura Nails representative shared:"The technology solution provided by SoftBuild has completely changed the way we operate. The new website system not only displays services professionally but also acts as a digital manager. Customers self-schedule, the system self-organizes, we save a lot of manual processing time. Growth figures in new customers and online booking rate have proven the practical effectiveness of this project."

See more:Professional website design costs

Conclusion

The Veloura Nails website project implemented by SoftBuild is a specific example of applying technology solutions directly to the local service business model to solve operational and growth problems. By designing the interface according to UI/UX standards of the beauty industry, integrating tools to automate the booking process and optimizing technical SEO, the website has successfully completed its role in attracting new customers and increasing revenue. Transparent quantitative metrics confirm the effectiveness of the implementation strategy, establishing a solid technical foundation for Veloura Nails to continue growing market share in the region.
